//pdn: Tiny Tapeout sg13g2 tile PDN: single layer (TopMetal1 vertical stripes, pitch 38.87 as in the ttihp-verilog-template config); pdn_cfg.tcl is LibreLane's without the per-macro grid (PDN-0233 with one layer), ERROR_ON_PDN_VIOLATIONS off because pdngen's check runs before the stripe step bridges the macro pins - LVS is the verdict
//sram_columns: Feed every supply column of the SRAMs, not just the ones the tile grid crosses: the left corridor uses only 73 of its 417 um for TopMetal1 and the layer runs at 6% after routing, so the stripes are affordable and the macro's internal mesh carries much less current (13 of 36 VDD! / 13 of 36 VSS! / 11 of 32 VDDARRAY! columns fed before).
//srams: Two 512x32 SRAM FIFOs (one per shard, 2 KB each) flush left with their pin faces toward each other; the 99.7 um gap holds both wrappers. Their power columns are Metal4 (2.81 um wide, VDD/VSS alternating every 5.62 um), so the TopMetal1 tile stripes crossing them are moved onto columns and tied down with Via4 + TopVia1 stacks by odb_stripes.py. Magic extracts the SRAM from its LEF abstract (Metal4 OBS keep-out bar at the VDD!/VDDARRAY! break), so the illegal-overlap check is waived as on CMOS5L; KLayout DRC and LVS are the verdict.
//: Heuristic diodes off since run 20 (they were a third of all cells and crowded the CFGMEM pin corners); the rule-based repair in the routing loop stays on
Post-route antenna repair rounds: the default 3 left two Metal3 nets over ratio 200 on run koA (see docs 4z.7)
//klayout_drc: Off in CI until the harden runs on a PDK newer than the January 2026 build LibreLane pins: that deck reports 5004 violations inside IHP's own SRAM cells (2316 on the bare macro GDS alone). The precheck job runs the September deck (tt-gds-action 7ef3d03) and is the DRC gate; local sign-off uses the IHP dev-branch deck through tools/drc_deck.py, which reports 0 on this tile. KLayout still writes the GDS: that is RUN_KLAYOUT_STREAMOUT.
//: A DRC report every 4 detailed-routing iterations, so tools/drt_status.py can show where a stalled route is stuck (and make harden-stop can end it)
Placement keep-outs (soft, density cap) in the rows outside each CFGMEM column's tile-facing edge at the pair gaps: every stalled route died there (see docs 4z.6)
//sram_gds: The SRAM GDS is a local copy of the PDK's with its PR boundary moved from layer 235/4 (older IHP release, unknown to Magic's tech and to the Tiny Tapeout layer whitelist) to 189/4, as in the CMOS5L PDK copy of the same macro
//layout: 8x4 ihp-sg13g2 tile (1724.16 x 710.64, core x 2.88-1721.28) with the two IHP 512x32 SRAM FIFOs stacked flush left (SRAM[0] FS at y 3.78, SRAM[1] N at y 340.20, pin faces toward each other) as on the CMOS5L tile. Single-layer TopMetal1 PDN (pitch 38.87, VPWR centres 16.48 + 38.87k). CFGMEM columns on that grid with the 5x4 macro builds: LEFT16 (rails 13.60 + 38.87k from its origin) at x 547.06 = 2.88 + 38.87*14 (127 um corridor to the SRAM), IHP16 (rails 17.25 + 38.87k) at x 1359.68 = -0.77 + 38.87*35 (30 um to the core's right edge). The stripe step draws TopMetal1 stripes on the SRAM's own Metal4 power columns and via stacks (Via4 + TopVia1) down to them.
